##### Project general facts

Lamar is a striking waterfront development that brings together four elegant apartment buildings on a beautifully designed shared podium. The project offers a refined mix of one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, complemented by spacious duplex penthouses with four bedrooms on the uppermost floors of each tower. At ground level, a collection of duplex townhouses lines the promenade, offering direct views over the water and complete living amenities for a truly elevated lifestyle.

Lamar is designed to deliver joyful, resort-style living through its rich collection of amenities. Residents can unwind by the swimming pool and gymnasium, enjoy the leisure deck with lush gardens, or relax in the exclusive terrace gardens scattered throughout the development. A vibrant waterfront promenade, a games room with a kids' play area, and inviting retail and dining outlets ensure there is always something wonderful to enjoy just steps from home.

Every home at Lamar reflects luxury in every detail, blending refined design with warm, inviting comfort. Interiors are thoughtfully finished with quality materials, elegant furnishings, and expansive glazing that fills each space with natural light and captivating views. From the stylish living areas to the beautifully appointed bedrooms, Lamar offers a serene and sophisticated setting for everyday living.

##### Location description and benefits 

Al Raha Beach comprises of four standout locations: Al Bandar, Al Hadeel, Al Muneera and Al Zeina; combined, the precincts offer fantastic facilities, including an exclusive clubhouse, retail outlets, and swimming pools; as well as an abundance of dining choices,landscaped lawns, and peaceful water fountains.

Al Raha Beach stands as a luxurious and captivating waterfront destination nestled along the pristine shores of Abu Dhabi. This master-planned community redefines modern living by seamlessly blending residential, commercial, and recreational elements in a harmonious coastal setting. With its stunning architecture, top-notch amenities, and panoramic views, Al Raha Beach offers a lifestyle of opulence and tranquility that reflects the pinnacle of Abu Dhabi's cosmopolitan charm.

Al Raha Beach is not merely a place to live; it's a destination for unparalleled leisure and recreation. The community boasts a wealth of world-class facilities, including pristine beaches that invite residents to unwind by the water's edge, exclusive gyms and sports centers that cater to fitness enthusiasts, and lush parks and landscaped areas that create serene spots for relaxation and socializing.
